label: Diagram 7.1
caption: Diagram 7.1 | Construction of protected shafts | Uninsulated glazed screens to protected shafts
description: The drawing is a plan view showing three protected shafts, A, B and C, within a building outline. Top left reads 'See para 7.23'; top right reads 'Fd Fire doorset'. A top paragraph notes the diagram shows three common examples illustrating the principles of the construction of protected shafts, with enclosing elements (unless formed by adjacent external walls) being compartment walls and floors. An arrow on the left points to the outer wall, labelled 'External wall'; a line points to a horizontal wall labelled 'Compartment wall'. Shaft A, top left, contains parallel screen lines and a door arc marked 'Fd', with text 'Protected shaft A is bounded on three sides by compartment walls and on the fourth side by an external wall'. Shaft B, centre, shows a staircase and two door arcs marked 'Fd', with text 'Protected shaft B is bounded on four sides by compartment walls'. Shaft C, right, shows four small circles and a door arc 'Fd', with text 'Protected shaft C is a services duct bounded on four sides by compartment walls'. A bottom paragraph refers to the shaft structure and compartment walls and external walls. A green foot bar reads 'Diagram 7.1 Construction of protected shafts'.

notes: The description says the 'Compartment wall' label points to a horizontal wall, but the drawing shows the leader pointing to the vertical compartment wall running down the middle of the building.
The description says shaft C shows four small circles, but the drawing shows five small circles along the left side of shaft C.
